claim: Mice can generate a cognitive map of an environment based on self-motion signals.
source: Mice can generate a cognitive map of an environment based on self-motion signals when there is a fixed association between their starting point and the location of their goal.
evidence: This is stated as a finding in the abstract of the manuscript.
